images.caption: Behind the scenes construction at the National Tramway Museum in Crich, Derbyshire, UK. The partially completed Bowes Lyon bridge can be seen on the left. The dragline excavator was being used to clear spoil in preparation for the development of the new Great Exhibition Hall. The running line is out of sight in the cutting that is bridged by the Bowes-Lyon Bridge, although the roof of a tram car on it can just be made out. The flat expanse on the other side of the bridge is the car park.
images.alt: Behind the scenes construction at the National Tramway Museum in Crich, Derbyshire, UK. The partially completed Bowes Lyon bridge can be seen on the left.
